title: Burs and Perforators for Drill Brace
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10172) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Burs and Perforators for Drill Brace.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Ready mixed paint, brushing, finishing, stoving for enamel color as required
Surgical Instruments - Corrosion Resistance of Stainless Steel Surgical Instruments - Methods of Tests

clause_3_terminology: Burs and Perforators for Drill Brace

marking_requirements: Marking — The perforators or burs shall be marked on their shank with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark and the diameter of working end.
